title: The evidence pack leaves out compliance decisions, the audit trail and screening reviews
evidence: shared/orchestration/evidence.py sections: deal, parties, PI/PO, documents, orders, ledger, journal, approvals, exceptions, emails, timeline, screening (party status only) — no compliance_checks / hold clearances, no audit_log entries for the deal, no directory screening_reviews (who cleared a possible sanctions match and why), no fees / FX records, no cost sheet
impact: The pack is what a bank, auditor, escrow provider or DGFT would ask for; the most sensitive decisions (HS policy confirmed Free, seal mismatch cleared, sanctions match cleared by two people) are exactly what is missing
fix: Add sections: compliance (checks, holds, clearances with reason and person), audit (audit_log entries with subject = deal or its parties, plus chain verify result), screening_reviews of both parties, fees and FX, cost sheet
why_money: a frozen payment or a customs query is answered in one file instead of weeks
